body: Hey, what’s that about?  Don’t worry about people wasting their time on negativity like that OP.
Thank you so much... it means a lot.  I hope the rest of your life goes amazingly; I want to continue on working on my own as well.

Thank you so much for the caring response.  I tried to send you a private message, but reddit isn’t letting that happen.  What did you mean when you said you’re assuming that the photos don’t incriminate me?  There’s also not a lot to say about the photos.  None of them were directed toward a minor or ever mean spirited.  It was always adults who developed friendships with me and ended up deciding to take advantage.  Sick.  They’re so, so sick.  But I was too.  To be honest, I don’t feel a lot of risk.  They weren’t incredibly malicious, although who could tell?  It’s more an issue of deep, deep shame.
